tts_summary: Hey there! Mario is at that lively two-month stretch where Golden Retrievers soak up social cues and start teething — since he's a rescue and a bit low-energy, you're probably seeing calm curiosity more than zoomies. Here's the thing: his socialization window and vaccine series matter now, so chat with your vet about his vaccine schedule if you haven't already. Goldens are naturally friendly and food-motivated, which makes short, frequent training sessions really effective. In an apartment with no yard, house-training and consistent routines (crate time, pads, short walks) are your daily focus. I set recommendations to support food, pads, and gentle training treats for Mario. Take a look at the recommendations below.
